coordinate_policy.reference_system: WGS84 latitude/longitude; local simulation coordinates use east/north/up metres
coordinate_policy.datum_interpretation: Inside the western portion of the publicly mapped P37 parking surface; not an organizer-provided waypoint
coordinate_policy.placement_check: All generated 2027 course mesh vertices, box corners and sampled cylindrical boundaries are inside the mapped P37 polygon, checked by independent winding-angle tests. The registered placement preserves the 152.4 m loop scale. The 0.75 m robot has a geometric free-space path between spawn and all four targets. This validates simulated geometry, not an official 2027 obstacle survey.
coordinate_policy.gps_accuracy: Coordinate decimal precision does not establish physical accuracy. Final 2027 competition waypoint coordinates and exact course placement were not available in the reviewed rules.
coordinate_policy.placement_classification: Rigid registration of the 2027 schematic to the historical 2026 main waypoint centroid and north-south bearing;2027 marker geometry preserved
coordinate_policy.scale_policy: The approximate area in the prose and illustrative 480-520 ft diagram do not define a surveyed scale. A route calibrated to 152.4 m can have a different physical footprint; the generated manifest must report its actual footprint separately.
coordinate_policy.historical_waypoint_reference: igvc2026_waypoints_reference.json; seven organizer-published2026 points decoded as packed DMS. Used only for geographic registration, not2027 survey geometry.
coordinate_policy.vertical_policy: USGS NAVD88 terrain is offset by272.1437180431318m at the retained local origin; existing286m WGS84 ellipsoid datum stays fixed. This declared alignment is not a geoid conversion or vertical survey.
coordinate_policy.site_feature_reference: p37_site_features.json; manually digitized pole feet and canopy centers, approximately1m horizontal placement accuracy, all vertical sizes inferred.

sources.title: University of Bridgeport IGVC 2025 design report

sources.observations: Page 10 shows medium-gray aggregate asphalt, faded yellow parking stalls and hatched end areas, bright white course tape, orange construction drums with reflective pale bands, dark barrel tops, grass, trees, and light poles. Its historical course has the start straight on the west and no-man's-land/ramp on the east; that arrangement must not be mistaken for the 2027 schematic.

sources.title: Organizer-linked AutoNav chicane and barrel walk-through
sources.role: Historical AutoNav materials and background reference
sources.year_note: File metadata indicates 2023; event capture date was not independently confirmed. Do not label this 2025 or 2026 footage.
sources.observations: Orange barrels have two broad white reflective bands and dark sandbags on top. Untaped corridor uses plain blue, red, white, black, green and yellow drums. Gray coarse asphalt carries faded yellow parking bays, black sealed cracks and irregular white tape. Background has grass, conifers/deciduous trees and light poles on concrete bases.
sources.reuse: Inspected locally; video and frames not redistributed.

sources.title: Organizer 2026 AutoNav GPS waypoints image
sources.observations: Seven numbered points: four main and three practice. The punctuation is interpreted as packed degrees/minutes/seconds, validated against P37; the image does not explicitly label coordinate encoding, horizontal datum or accuracy. WGS84 is an explicit simulation assumption.2026 points must not be presented as 2027 surveyed targets.
sources.reuse: Numeric facts transcribed; copyrighted source image not redistributed.

sources.title: Oakland County 2025 TC/CIR orthophoto image service
sources.role: Real site surface appearance and visible curb, tree, parking marking and light-pole placement
sources.observations: Leaf-off imagery resolves cracked gray asphalt, faded parking markings, perimeter curb notches, north grass strip and roundabout, south woodland/grass, and light poles. No raised interior parking islands are visible in the principal P37 asphalt area. This predates the 2027 course and supplies site context, not obstacle arrangement.
sources.reuse: Oakland County Open Data terms explicitly allow downloading, copying, modifying, adapting, distributing and reusing data for lawful purposes. Source is provided without warranty.

sources.title: USGS 3DEP one-meter Oakland County bare-earth elevation
sources.role: Measured broad site relief; no invented terrain bumps
sources.observations: The public image-service export is explicitly locked to raster ID 138625 and uses raw F32 values with bilinear reprojection. Source resolution is 1 m; exported EPSG:3857 pixel spacing is a projection quantity. Bare-earth data supports parking-lot grade and broad berms but cannot resolve exact curb faces or current pavement condition.
